question: Show the names and departments of all students.
How many students are in the Computer Science department?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students WHERE department = 'Computer Science';

question: What is the average age of all students?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(age) AS average_age FROM students;

question: List all courses ordered from highest to lowest credits, breaking ties alphabetically by course name.
gold_sql: SELECT course_name, credits FROM courses ORDER BY credits DESC, course_name ASC;

question: How many students are in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY department;

question: Which enrollments currently have a missing grade?
gold_sql: SELECT e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, e.course_id FROM enrollments AS e JOIN grades AS g ON e.enrollment_id = g.enrollment_id WHERE g.grade IS NULL;

question: Which departments have an average student age of at least 21?
gold_sql: SELECT department, AVG(age) AS average_age FROM students GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(age) >= 21;

question: List the top 3 departments with the highest average recorded grade.
gold_sql: SELECT s.department, AVG(g.grade) AS average_grade FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN grades AS g ON e.enrollment_id = g.enrollment_id GROUP BY s.department ORDER BY average_grade DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Find the IDs and names of students who are not enrolled in any course.
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, name FROM students EXCEPT SELECT s.student_id, s.name FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id;

question: List the names of students and the courses where they earned a grade higher than the overall average grade.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, c.course_name, g.grade FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN grades AS g ON e.enrollment_id = g.enrollment_id WHERE g.grade > (SELECT AVG(grade) FROM grades);

question: Which students are enrolled in courses totaling more than 6 credits, and how many total credits are they taking?
gold_sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.name, SUM(c.credits) AS total_credits FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name HAVING SUM(c.credits) > 6 ORDER BY total_credits DESC, s.name ASC;

question: Find the names of students who have both an enrollment in a 4-credit course and at least one recorded grade above 85.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.credits = 4 INTERSECT SELECT s.name FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN grades AS g ON e.enrollment_id = g.enrollment_id WHERE g.grade > 85;
